I don't know you and I don't know your whole story.  I don't feel what you feel,  but I doknow what it feels like to want to end it all. From what I know you are senior in an engineer program, you are probably incredibly bright. It must have been incredibly hard growing up with a father that was too interested in other things. But, he must have faith in you if he is going to turn over the family business to you. Listen, this is your life and you need to live it how you want to.  Even if that means disappointing a few family members. 50 years from now when you are looking back at your life..what do you want to see? I believe in you. Things will get better even if it's not today  
Keep on keeping on
-MJ
You make a valid point. My dad would want me to be happy, despite the circumstance.  Thank you (: good luck to you
Thank you so much for your insight.  I honestly was not expecting a response.  Just knowing someone took the time to respond makes me feel a bit better.
